title: Advanced Mobile Journalism (MoJo)
description: A hands-on workshop on using smartphones for high-quality news reporting and storytelling.
fullDescription: This intensive workshop covered the A-Z of Mobile Journalism (MoJo). Participants learned about the best apps for shooting and editing video, framing techniques, audio recording on mobile, and how to tell compelling visual stories using only a smartphone. The session included practical exercises where participants produced a short news package by the end of the day.

title: Strategic Planning for Investigative Stories
description: Workshop on planning and executing long-form investigative journalism projects.
fullDescription: Focused on the strategic aspect of investigative reporting, this workshop guided participants through the process of hypothesis formation, source mapping, and creating a project timeline. We discussed risk assessment, digital security, and how to structure a complex narrative. Changing the mindset from daily news coverage to deep-dive investigations was a key theme.

title: Digital Verification & Fact-Checking
description: Techniques for verifying digital content and fighting misinformation.
fullDescription: In an era of fake news, this workshop provided essential skills for verifying user-generated content. Tools and techniques for reverse image search, video verification, and geolocation were demonstrated. The workshop also covered the ethical considerations of using social media content in news reporting.
